newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-PARTIZAN BEAT CROATIA IN BALKAN CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARTIZAN BEAT CROATIA IN BALKAN CLASH.

text.p: A goal six minutes before time gave Partizan Belgrade a 1-0 advantage over Croatia Zagreb in the first leg of a European Cup qualifier on Wednesday.

In a match remarkable more for the heavy police presence in and around the stadium than the quality of play, striker Dragan Isailovic slipped the ball through goalkeeper Drazen Ladic's legs to clinch the game.

Croatia failed to realise at least four scoring chances against a home side obviously burdened by the importance of the game, the first direct sporting contact between Yugoslavia and Croatia on the soil of former Yugoslavia since the 1991 war.
The winner after the second leg in Zagreb on July 30 will face England's Newcastle United in the preliminary round of the competition.
